notes.title: Update 1.3.0 now available for download
notes.content:
Dear Captain,

Our latest update is now live!
We've greatly improved the early game, enhanced the overall experience through some handy quality-of-life changes and added some new stuff to encounter.

The update includes the following changes:

[list]
[*]Improved readability on all ships - silhuette changes and color changes make all ships visually unique
[*]on ships dying there is a chance for a ship-wreck to spawn, which can be used as ammunition
[*]arc strike is awarded very early
[*]attack loop has also been moved into early game to provide more variety
[*]On battle restart all dialogs/cutscenes you already heard will be skipped automatically
[*]Equipped Argo Upgrades now are shown on the HUD
[*]Asteroid levels are deterministic now, and will always spawn the asteroids in the same manner (and easier)
[*]Early game missions have been improved, including a new enemy type launching assault-pods
[*]Weapon telegraphing improved on several weapons, which were difficult to read
[*]more argo upgrades earlier to introduce choice earlier
[*]new enemy weapon introduced to hard-counter attack paths
[*]increased difficulty in early game
[/list]

Your Drone Swarm Crew

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 now available for download
notes.content:
Dear Captain,

We have just released the update 1.1.0!  We worked on fixing many issues. Next to it we also add an unique Halloween mode.

See all changelogs in detail here:

- physical swarm abilities balanced to make bigger ships less affected 
- Psionic burst cannon now also targets single ships instead of requiring a group of ships to shoot
- Gate animations are now always triggered in cluster transition systems
- reduced the damage any ship takes from just the drone impact for physical abilities
- transit state drones are invulnerable (so when they return to the Argo, they cannot be harmed on the way)
- fixed various issues with swarmpools (orb of power, warpout, returning to the correct pool)
- improve shield scrambler to actually target the right ships and show an fx on the ship that is affected by the component disable modifier
- fixed interaction with energy attack drones and skin shields, allowing to do damage through the shield
- Seamless Travel between systems
- Improved stability on battle restart
- Improved setup of missions in Chapter 7 and 8 according to feedback
- resolutions below 1080p are now supported with appropriate text rendering
- HALLOWEEN - turn on Halloween mode in the settings to turn your drones into a swarm of bats
- fixed remaining ui-layouting bugs

Known Issue:
-On some machines it can happen that videos are not played correctly (can be skipped by holding "F" pressed)

Your Drone Swarm Crew

notes.title: Drone Swarm is out now!
notes.content:
Good day, Captain!

[b]Drone Swarm is out now![/b]

Control a swarm of 32,000 drones in this strategy-adventure set in space! Jump from system to system and battle powerful alien fleets. Destroy enemy vessels, slam them into one another, block attacks and outsmart defenses.

• Control a vast swarm of 32,000 drones

• Think quick and defeat your alien opponents in fast-paced space battles

• Keep adapting your tactics to counter ever more challenging enemy fleets and loadouts

• Use and combine unique swarm abilities to efficiently defend and attack simultaneously

• Evolve your swarm and upgrade your mothership to withstand the enemy

• Journey through an expansive story campaign featuring over 100 encounters

• Use your environment to your advantage and outsmart the enemy


https://store.steampowered.com/app/401760/Drone_Swarm/

notes.title: Reveal of Drone Swarm’s Story
notes.content:
Dear Captain,

We are extremely happy to reveal the story of Drone Swarm today. Learn more about Captain Carter, the Argo, and humanity’s fate in this fast-paced strategy-adventure. 

21st January 2111 – Out of nowhere a gigantic sphere arrived in our orbit and a swarm of alien drones attacked the earth. This was the day life as we knew it came to an end. Families were ripped apart and cities were destroyed, but people fought to survive until the very end. However, mankind did not stand a chance…

Your main mission as Captain Carter is to find a new earth for the last human survivors after this catastrophic attack has forced them to flee their home planet. Now that everything you once knew has been reduced to ashes, you have become humanity’s last hope. Watch the trailer to find out how they succeeded. You can enable English, French and German subtitles:

[previewyoutube=5_B9SycFIIo;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you enjoy the Story Trailer as these cutscenes and voice-overs will drive the story within the game as well and accompany you on your dangerous journey to find a new earth. 

Stay tuned for more announcements to come in the months ahead.  

Your Drone Swarm Crew

notes.title: Drone Swarm | Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Dear Captain, 

We are happy to present the first episode of our multi-part Dev Diary series today: Introducing the Gameplay.

In this first episode Julian Mautner, Game Director of Drone Swarm, focuses on the unique gameplay approach and the control of the swarm. He shows the basics of the game, introduces different types of enemies and their attacks, and explains the fascinating swarm behavior.

[previewyoutube=tMjcUzrmaYU;full][/previewyoutube]

The Dev Diary features subtitles in English, German and French.

Your Drone Swarm Crew
